title: Doesn’t Turn Well
text: Doesn’t Turn Well. For some reason, the grater part likes to pop out while you’re grating. You have to keep a thumb pressing the grey edge of the grater down as you grate. You also have to cut your cheese to fit into the handle. Once you’ve got the cheese properly sit and your thumb firmly holding the grater edge, it works well. It is a little too difficult for a kid to use.

description: A cheese grater with a Chef’n spin on things. This clever rotary grater has a spring-loaded chamber, so you don't have to push as you grate. The re-imagined hand grater has open sides that let you see how much you're grating. Just turn the geared handle with the easy-to-grip knob, for fast and comfortable grating directly over dishes. The high-quality cutting blade is durable and non-absorbent, with rust-resistant teeth that stay sharp. The perfect addition to every cheese lover’s kitchen. Pieces come apart for easy cleaning. Hand wash recommended for blade. Choose smart, easy-to-use kitchen utensils that are built on tasteful design, new technologies, and the trusted reputation of Chef'n.
